I am 60 years old. I have farmed this land in Quzhou for 35 years. I never went to school, but I know every corner of my 12 mu. I learned everything by doing it and watching my neighbors. If Lao Wang's wheat looks good, I do what Lao Wang does. I do not trust new ideas unless I saw them work on someone else's field first.

I keep 8 mu for wheat and then maize, and 4 mu for cotton. That is how I have done it for many years. My household has four mouths, so a bad harvest is a disaster. I would rather spend a little more on fertilizer than risk losing yield. Fertilizer is money, but an empty granary is worse.

The wheat is already in the ground from last October. I used improved seed, about 30 jin per mu. Before sowing, I spread one bag of compound fertilizer on each mu — the one from the dealer that says 18-22-5 on it. Now that spring is here, I will topdress with half a bag of urea per mu when the wheat turns green. Last year I did this and got about 2000 jin per mu. I irrigate three times from my well: greening water, jointing water, and grain-filling water. I spray three times for bugs, weeds, and that white powder disease.

After I cut the wheat in June, I plant maize the same day. No time to waste. I buy hybrid seed from the shop, two and a half jin per mu. I put one bag of compound fertilizer in the furrow when planting — the 27-6-7 kind. I do not plough for maize anymore. I plant straight into the wheat stubble, like everyone else now. The summer rains help, so I only water twice if it gets dry. I spray three times: herbicide once, and insecticide twice.

For cotton, I plant 4 mu in April. I use improved cotton seed, about 4 jin per mu. Cotton needs more food and more medicine than grain. I put one bag of compound fertilizer per mu at planting — the one with 16-14-18 — then later I add half a bag of urea when it flowers. I irrigate three times. Cotton has many bugs, bollworms and aphids, so I spray ten times from June to August. Last year my cotton gave me about 1000 jin per mu of seed cotton. I hope for the same this year.
